<template>
  <v-row>
    <v-col>

</template>

<script>
export default {
  name: 'DashboardView',
  data() {
    return {
      value: false
    }
  },
  methods: {
    logout() {
      localStorage.removeItem('AUTH_TOKEN');
      this.$router.push(this.$route.query.redirect || '/login');
    }
  }
}

</script>

.custom-title {
  font-size: 29px;

}

.custom-subtitle {
  font-size: 19px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: black !important;
}

.custom-v-card-iframe {
  height: 60vh;
}

.custom-iframe {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}
</style>
